headline: Renewed Middle East Unrest Pushes Up Strong Dollar, Shrinks Risk Appetite... 'Slight Rise From Previous Day' [Exchange Rate Outlook]
summary: The won-dollar intraday range is forecast at 1,330 to 1,345 won for the 13th. Renewed Middle East unrest pushed up the dollar and reduced risk appetite.
why: The won-dollar rate reflects the relative value of the Korean won against the US dollar, which is the main reserve and trade currency.
why_moved: Renewed Middle East unrest pushed up the dollar and reduced risk appetite, pressuring the won.
